categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of superhard cutting tools, hard alloy cutting tools, and diamond functional materials. Its business segments include superhard tools, hard alloy tools, and cultivated diamond and CVD diamond functional materials. It also engages in the development, production, and sales of polishing and grinding machines.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies such as superhard material laser micro-nano precision processing, vacuum application technology, ultra-thin diamond sheet precision grinding and polishing, automated equipment manufacturing, high-precision superhard and hard alloy CNC blade production, and CVD diamond growth technology. It uses advanced laser processing, vacuum sintering, chemical vapor deposition (CVD) methods, and automated manufacturing equipment to produce its products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in industries such as consumer electronics (3C), automotive, wind power, aerospace, precision molds, engineering machinery, and general machinery. The company serves global high-end tool markets and has established long-term partnerships with internationally renowned enterprises, focusing on both domestic and international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Hebei (Langfang), Zhejiang (Jiaxing), and Guangdong (Shenzhen and Huizhou). It has expanded internationally with a subsidiary in Germany and personnel in Mexico, actively participating in global markets including Europe, North America, Mexico, India, and Thailand.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, producing cutting tools and functional diamond materials. It also extends upstream by developing and manufacturing key raw materials such as PCD composite sheets and hard alloy rods, and produces automated equipment for tool manufacturing, forming an integrated supply chain from raw materials to finished high-end tools.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding global high-end tool market share, developing hard alloy and metal-ceramic tools, and cultivating diamond and CVD diamond functional materials as a second growth curve. R&D focuses on new product development for titanium alloy processing, PCBN milling cutters for ball joints and ball screws, and advanced CVD diamond growth technologies. The company emphasizes innovation in laser processing, vacuum technologies, and automated manufacturing equipment.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of superhard cutting tools, hard alloy tools, diamond functional materials, and related equipment. Sales are conducted via direct sales and distribution channels, including OEM/ODM arrangements. Export sales contribute significantly to revenue growth.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a domestic leader in integrated cutting tool solutions with a strong position in the superhard tool market. It competes with international giants like Sandvik, Kennametal, and ISCAR in high-end segments. The company differentiates itself through comprehensive product lines, advanced technology, and expanding international presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 602.9 million, a 45.52% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 97.37 million, a 55% increase. The company has steadily grown its asset base to over RMB 2.13 billion and maintains positive cash flow from operations, reflecting a robust growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-precision, high-performance cutting tools with advanced materials such as PCD and PCBN composites, and cultivated diamond products. It emphasizes integrated solutions, customization capabilities with over 55,000 tailor-made tool designs, and superior product quality comparable to international brands. Its vertical integration and proprietary technologies enable cost control and innovation leadership.
